name: sub2_rockhead_flareblitz_substitute_arcanine
purpose: Rock Head (data/abilities.ts rockhead, onDamage cancels the recoil 'recoil' effect, not Struggle's) on Arcanine-Hisui: Flare Blitz (recoil) into the foe's standing Substitute (Snorlax). The absorbed hit's recoil is cancelled by Rock Head: the user's HP stays, while the Substitute takes the hit. Before the fix, the engine's Substitute path applied the recoil.
